summary: Sean Haberthier, 47, of Denver, was reported missing ~5 p.m. Thursday after a day of skiing at Breckenridge Ski Resort; the Summit County Sheriff's Office and Breckenridge Ski Patrol conducted an extensive overnight search. Searchers found him ~8:30 a.m. Friday near the expert Lower Boneyard run off the Peak 8 six-chair; pronounced dead on scene from an apparent tree collision. The coroner confirmed a severe skull fracture; he was not wearing a helmet.
location: Lower Boneyard run, Peak 8, Breckenridge Ski Resort
responding_agency: Summit County Sheriff's Office; Breckenridge Ski Patrol
notes: Reported missing Thursday 2017-01-12 ~5 p.m.; found Friday 2017-01-13 ~8:30 a.m. Second Breckenridge tree-collision ski fatality that season per the article.
